args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary - Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost driver for retailers.
- Consolidating returns processing into dedicated hubs cut handling costs by about 20%.
- Companion piece: reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of their original margin, reinforcing the value of fast, consolidated returns handling.
